verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets in-product AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts, escalate complex cases, and make decisions that users can review or override, so AI does produce in-product judgments on the user's own data. The evidence is short marketing snippets, though, and shows automated decisions rather than insights or suggestions surfaced to the user. missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights/explanations or recommendations shown to users, detail on how agent outputs are presented in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
